svg.desc: HB 871 to HIRUMA, in flight; MD 449 to FT_TRANSCENDANCE, in flight; EH 661 to 42-LIBASM, on time; EH 586 to 42-INCEPTION, diverted; EH 914 to BUNNY, exp 04:20; EH 989 to BRAINFXCKER, exp 17:10; EH 147 to 42-HOTRACE, delayed; EH 462 to 42-ALCU, exp 14:40; EH 239 to 42-WEBSERV, gate closed; EH 177 to 42-FT_SHMUP, gate closed; EH 880 to 42-LIBUNIT, gate closed; SU 957 to SPINUP, gate closed; EH 522 to 42-CPP_09, gate closed; EH 863 to 42-FT_NM, gate closed; EH 104 to 42-CUB3D, departed; EH 391 to 42-PHILOSOPHERS, departed; EH 186 to 42-MINISHELL, departed; EH 195 to OBANAIBOT, cancelled

EH 586 42-INCEPTION — My personal Inception for Milestone 5. Let's learn Docker!
EH 989 BRAINFXCKER — Have you ever dreamt about compiling Brainfuck? No? Well, it is now possible.
EH 147 42-HOTRACE — Our own Hotraces for the Rushes. Fast and efficient research!
EH 462 42-ALCU — Our own AlCu for the Rushes. Don't be the last one to pick the cat!
EH 239 42-WEBSERV — Our personal webserv for Milestone 5. Stand proud Nginx, you are strong...
EH 177 42-FT_SHMUP — Our own ft_shmup for the Rushes. Pew pew, shoot 'em all!
EH 880 42-LIBUNIT — Our own libunit for the Rushes. Life is better with a testing framework.
SU 957 SPINUP — Build your own web-apps in a single command. 100% customisable.
EH 522 42-CPP_09 — My tenth module for Milestone 5. Let's use the whole STL with containers.
EH 104 42-CUB3D — Our own cub3d for Milestone 4. Our first RayCasting program in C, with the MiniLibX.
EH 391 42-PHILOSOPHERS — My personal Philosophers for Milestone 3. Resolving the Dining Philosophers problem with multi-threading (mutexes).
EH 186 42-MINISHELL — Our own minishell for Milestone 3. A reproduction of the bash environment with its command interpretation.
THANK YOU FOR FLYING EHOSTA
